info.title: Certree API
info.description: Browser administrator API uses sessions, Origin and CSRF. Agent v1 uses per-agent bearer credentials over HTTPS; enrollment uses a single-use 15-minute key scoped to an environment. Agent reload reports never imply successful deployment until central live TLS verification.
